dependency_semantics: Conditional induction nodes state the full previous-depth theorem as a premise. They are implication schemata, not edges assuming the same-depth conclusion. Open means independent mathematical review is still pending, even when engineer evidence or a compiler result is present.

routes.name: Scalar independence on higher-rank zero sectors
routes.retired_because: A vector in a higher-rank product subspace may be entangled across counted sites. Binary mismatch outcomes are then not independent; the replacement route uses an operator inequality.

C9000274.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 274 (Parity is not in QAC<sup>0</sup>.; papers: Product-projection localization and the QAC0 parity lower bound; Regular trajectories, pruning and quantum parity; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/274.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

S_SCOPE.statement: The staged papers prove different qubit/rank-one dependency chains; neither asserts the dimension- and rank-uniform extension.

S_POLY.statement: First manuscript, lem:polynomial: an integer zero filter has degree and weighted coefficient logarithm below N^u for u>(a+b)/2.

S_BASE.statement: First manuscript, lem:base: rank-one product factors give a depth-zero squared transition bound 2^(-r).

S_LOW.statement: First manuscript, lem:propagation: previous-depth localization extends from a zero pattern to all low-count patterns.

S_SMALL.statement: First manuscript, lem:small-support: ordered reflection expansion costs at most 9^k and reduces a k-site projection by one depth.

S_BACK.statement: First manuscript, lem:backward: under the previous-depth hypothesis, B_d(t,b) implies B_d(s,t) whenever s<t<b<2t-s.

S_LOC.statement: First manuscript, thm:localization: uniform qubit product-projection localization at every fixed depth and exponent pair.

S_PARITY_LOC.statement: First manuscript, thm:parity: complementary Hadamard matrix entries and character orthogonality convert localization to a measured-output parity lower bound.

T_DEGREE.statement: Second manuscript, lem:degree-shift: operator degree bounds excitation shifts.

T_FILTERS.statement: Second manuscript, lem:zero-filter and lem:tail-filter: integer zero approximation and a globally nonnegative tail polynomial with global growth control.

T_PROP.statement: Second manuscript, prop:propagation: low-degree perturbations propagate along an assumed regular trajectory, using a qubit Pauli coefficient bound.

T_TRANSPORT.statement: Second manuscript, lem:tail-transport: two already regular trajectories linked by an endpoint projection transfer excitation tails.

T_INSERT.statement: Second manuscript, prop:projection-insertion: backward suffix induction preserves regularity after an endpoint product projection.

T_OVERLAP.statement: Second manuscript, cor:product-tail and cor:overlap-tail: for a regular product-input trajectory the output tail is multiplied by the projection probability, not its square root.

T_RETAIN.statement: Second manuscript, lem:retained-layer: mean counts, binary low-weight atom counting, and recentering make gates with probability at least m^(-6) regular.

T_PRUNE.statement: Second manuscript, prop:pruning: prefix induction yields a regular pruned circuit within vector distance 2t m^(-2) on the specified product input.

T_PARITY.statement: Second manuscript, thm:parity: reference copies, pruning, and the product-input tail contradict fixed measured-output parity advantage.

C_SOS.statement: For arbitrary idempotents P,Q in a unital ring, P-PQ(2-P)QP=(P-PQP)^2; for orthogonal projections the right side is a positive square.

C_BASE_GENERAL.statement: For arbitrary local orthogonal projections and r>=0, the squared product-projection transition from the zero count is at most 2^(-r), including entangled zero-sector inputs.

C_DIM_CORE.statement: For arbitrary finite complex matrices representing orthogonal projections P,Q, B=PQ(2I-P)QP and P-B are positive semidefinite with explicit Gram identities; positive tensor-order composition and the nonnegative-scalar compressed-tail implication hold for arbitrary finite matrix sizes.

C_PATTERN_GENERAL.statement: Assuming all dimension-uniform depth-(d-1) localization pairs, binary subspace patterns give ||[M>=N^beta]B[M<N^alpha]||<=exp(-N^sigma) for beta>max(alpha,sigma), with a threshold depending only on depth and the exponents.

C_SMALL_GENERAL.statement: Assuming all dimension-uniform depth-(d-1) localization pairs, depth-d conjugation of product projections on at most N^u sites has transition at most exp(-N^w) to count N^t for t>max(u,w); the reflection expansion costs at most 9^k.

C_POLY_GENERAL.statement: For fixed 0<a<b and u>(a+b)/2, the explicit root-Chebyshev polynomial has p(0)=1, degree and log weighted coefficient norm at most N^u, and integer error at most exp(-N^a) through ceil(N^b), with no b<=1 restriction.

C_BACKWARD_GENERAL.statement: Assuming all dimension-uniform depth-(d-1) pairs and the universal same-depth pair B_d(t,b), one-sided polynomial substitution after squaring and exact inverse count exchange prove B_d(s,t) whenever 0<=s<t<b<2t-s.

C_SCALE_GENERAL.statement: For every 0<=s<t<=1 the recurrence with eta=(t-s)^2/100 reaches a tail exponent greater than one within ceil(2/(t-s)) steps, keeping t_i<t_(i+1)<2t_i-s_i; hence the conditional backward implication yields all depth-d pairs from the previous-depth theorem.

C_TRANSFER.statement: Under the full dimension-uniform previous-depth hypothesis, binary subspace patterns, ordered reflection expansion, coefficient-controlled polynomials, inverse count exchange, and the finite scale induction prove every depth-d localization pair with dimension-free thresholds.

C_DIM_UNIFORM.statement: For every fixed d and 0<=s<t there exists N0(d,s,t) such that arbitrary finite local dimensions, arbitrary-rank product-reflection circuits at depth d, and arbitrary local-projection counts M,D satisfy ||[M>=N^t]U[D=0]U*[M=0]||<=exp(-N^s) for N>=N0.

C_SCALAR_INDEP.statement: For arbitrary higher-rank local projections, a normalized product projection applied to every vector in a product zero-count subspace produces independent binary mismatch outcomes on the counted sites.
